Bachelor of Information Technology and Computing

BITC programme information at Kyambogo University.

Year 1

Semester I

6 Courses
  • Humanities and Communications Skills
  • Introduction to Information Technology and Computing
  • Computer Applications
  • Discrete Mathematical Structures
  • Probability and Statistics
  • Differential, Integral and Vector Calculus

Semester II

6 Courses
  • Fundamentals of Programming
  • Introduction to Data Communications
  • Database Fundamentals
  • Web Design and Development
  • Operating Systems Concepts
  • Ethics and Professional Issues in IT

Year 2

Semester I

5 Courses
  • Network Management Concepts and Security
  • Numerical Analysis and Computation
  • Structured Programming
  • Information Systems and Design
  • Introduction to Data Communications and Networking

Semester II

5 Courses
  • Object-Oriented Programming
  • Database Systems Design and Development
  • System Analysis and Design
  • Multimedia Systems
  • Software Engineering Principles

Year 3

Semester I

6 Courses
  • Intermediate Data Communication and Networking
  • Distributed Computing Systems
  • Data Structure and Algorithms
  • Introduction to Graph Theory
  • Entrepreneurship Skills
  • Computer Graphics

Semester II

6 Courses
  • Advanced Networking
  • Research Methods
  • Project/Dissertation
  • E-Commerce and Web Services
  • Information Systems Security
  • Cloud Computing Concepts
